fieldValues.title: 3. Status, holds and routing
fieldValues.thinking_reached: The GitHub Project Status field plus label mirrors: 'status: in progress', 'status: in review', ready, promote:ready, blocked, needs-input, parked; eleven gate:* labels (dispatched, blocked-owner, in-review, working, auto-merge, owner-merge, external-work, pool, session-unit, queued, needs-input); wg:* (the working group that holds the problem's domain) and lane:unattended (central lane). The programme binds a work-status set to label text through label-binding records (decision f58db200).
fieldValues.tensions:
- gate:* mixes three things: workflow state (working, in-review, queued, dispatched), holds (needs-input, blocked-owner, external-work) and merge authority (auto-merge, owner-merge).
- 'in review' and 'needs-input' exist both as status/hold labels and as gate labels.
- Not re-verified in this pass: what each gate:* label means today and who writes it.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: - Which of the eleven gate labels are still read by any tool?
fieldValues.next_action: Audit the gate:* labels against label-binding records and the tools that read them.
